summary.text: Patrick Duvendeck is the Republican candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 69 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Democratic Rep. Jasper Martus.
An electrical engineer, he described himself in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey as a small business owner and retired General Motors professional.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Duvendeck graduated from Houghton Lake High School, earned an associate degree from Mott Community College in 1981, and received a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan, Flint in 1985.
He said in the 2026 survey that over a more than 40-year career at General Motors he rose from UAW electrician to Manager of Machining Controls Systems Engineering.
Duvendeck won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary unopposed.

His stated priorities include attracting good-paying jobs to Genesee County, lowering energy costs, cutting income taxes, addressing state waste and overspending, and strengthening literacy instruction in schools.
